```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r treatment effects table}
# Load the following packages -------------
packages <- c("stargazer", 
              "dplyr", 
              "haven",
              "estimatr"  # for robust standard errors
              )
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = FALSE) # switch to TRUE to install packages 

# Load the sample data set --------------
data <- read_dta("/Users/koniks/Downloads/nlsw88.dta")
dir.create("Outputs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Create the data frame --------------
df_treatment <- data %>%
  select(wage,           # Outcome variable
         hours,          # Alternative outcome
         union,          # Treatment variable (replace with your treatment)
         age,            # Control variables
         married,
         ttl_exp,
         collgrad,
         south)

# Run the Regressions --------------------
model1 <- lm(wage ~ union, data = df_treatment)
model2 <- lm(wage ~ union + age + married + ttl_exp, data = df_treatment)
model3 <- lm(wage ~ union + age + married + ttl_exp + collgrad + south, data = df_treatment)
model4 <- lm(hours ~ union + age + married + ttl_exp + collgrad + south, data = df_treatment)

# Create the Table ----------------------
stargazer(model1,
          model2, 
          model3,
          model4,
          title = "Treatment Effects: Impact of Union Membership on Labor Outcomes",
          column.labels = c("Wage", "Wage", "Wage", "Hours"),
          covariate.labels = c("Union member (Treatment)",
                              "Age",
                              "Married", 
                              "Total experience",
                              "College graduate",
                              "Lives in South",
                              "Constant"),
          dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
          dep.var.caption = "",
          keep.stat = c("n", "adj.rsq"),
          header = FALSE,
          notes = c("Standard errors in parentheses.",
                   "Treatment variable: Union membership (1=Union, 0=Non-union)"),
          notes.append = FALSE,
          out = "Outputs/treatment-effects.tex")
```
